changes: Security: server now listens on 127.0.0.1 only - LAN devices cannot access it
Security: CORS restricted to local origins - malicious web pages cannot read API data cross-origin
Security: DeepSeek key no longer stored in plaintext - encrypted file + in-memory unlock only
Security: access token verification - blind cross-site requests to local APIs are fully blocked
Security: new status change history table with a unified status-update entry - every change (create/complete/abandon/drag/batch) is recorded
Security: npm audit 0 vulnerabilities, dependency tree kept under continuous audit
Timeline view: new timeline view alongside date/project views - sub-tasks rendered as 30-day bars, whole-bar drag to shift dates, click/double-click/drag clearly separated

Auto repeat tasks: weekly/monthly repeat, latest occurrence auto-created on startup and at day rollover, date-suffixed names with full sub-task copies; manage centrally in Settings (stop / switch frequency)
AI form highlighting: one-click AI annotation in the task form - read-only layer shows highlights/reasons/suggestions/questions; accept marks the text red, cancel leaves the form unchanged
HTML dynamic skins: themes can provide dynamic HTML backgrounds (double sandbox + CSP + parent isolation), per-theme toggle persisted across restarts, graceful fallback to the static image on errors
New theme: Children of Sunny - hand-drawn warm theme with mote & meteor animations and frosted-glass translucency
Bilingual support: full Chinese/English UI switching, server error messages follow the language, bilingual quotes
Carry-over improvements: respects the task start date (future tasks stay put); new tasks land on their start date
Backup & restore: database download/import with header validation; import button text follows the language
Fix: NW.js background processes lingering after closing the window (second launch unresponsive)
Fix: task export switched to CSV download (UTF-8 BOM, opens directly in Excel), content verified
Fix: Morita quote Chinese/English mismatch ("50 years" was wrongly "10 years/decade")
Fix: date bar text invisible and dynamic background disappearing after idle under dynamic skins
Cleanup: removed legacy Electron source, runtime and build toolchain (~500MB)
Cleanup: removed Claude Code related files and documentation wording
Automated tests: API regression suite expanded to 66 cases, all passing
Task lifecycle: daily_records mechanism - in-progress/paused tasks carry over across days, completed/cancelled stay on their date
Project board: four drag-and-drop columns (Paused/Cancelled/In Progress/Completed), @dnd-kit, double-click to edit
Sub-task chains: set the next sub-task (uniqueness + cycle detection), auto-jump after completion, finished ones skipped
Auto status derivation: with sub-tasks the main status derives from them; manual otherwise
Status sync rules: 12 drag sync rules; saving distinguishes manual status change from sub-task changes
AI assistant 3-step flow: natural language parsing → follow-up questions → create one by one, with multi-task split
Review system: retrospectives table, plan vs actual in 8 dimensions, Markdown export per task/project
Themes: 4 built-in themes (Deep Blue / Dark Green / Warm Orange / Light Gray), CSS variables, custom themes without compiling
Simple/full modes: first-launch guide, switchable anytime; simple mode hides THEMRPR and sub-tasks
Backup & restore: database download/upload with SQLite header validation
Search: full-text search across all dates, AutoComplete dropdown, cross-view jump
Automated tests: 30 API regression cases, zero dependencies, isolated database
Duration calculation: remaining = planned - (today - created); overdue shows as 'X days overdue'
Numbering: letters computed dynamically per date; history unaffected
Date navigation: week/month switching + weekday selector
Board table: main tasks / sub-tasks / THEMRPR inheritance logic
Bottom actions: create / complete / abandon / delete + automatic progress reports
Port conflicts handled: multi-port fallback + auto-exit when the parent process quits
